data.title: Unit 12: The solar system
The sun and the planets
data.caption: Venus fact file
data.text: Venus is the hottest planet in the solar system. Venus is surrounded by a very thick atmosphere.
Venus is the only planet in the solar system that spins from east to west on its axis.
Venus is the only planet that takes longer to rotate on its axis than to orbit around the Sun.
This means a day on Venus is longer than a year.
